Jordan M.: FYI starting an onboarding thread for Vectora-13B POC. Customer: Doc-summarization + chat. Needs two things: (A) catalog compatibility check, (B) clean POC pricing + Dedicated ramp plan. Target p95 ~200ms on short prompts.

Rhea V.: Ill take compat. Ask: do they require VPC/KMS in the POC or can we do hosted first? Also need sample token distribution and any special function-calling examples.

Jordan M.: They prefer Private for security review but will accept hosted for initial perf runs. Token mix: 65% <=64, 25% 65-512, 10% >512. Function-calling later. SOC2 required.

Kai L.: Ran a quick local model-scan. Notes: SentencePiece tokenizer with 2 custom control tokens; rotary dims mixed (64/128) so kernel selection needed; q4_0 looks promising but recommend validating on real prompts. INF ticket suggested.

OpsBot: vscan-22011 -> tokenizer adapter recommended; runtime kernel tweak advised; quant candidates q4_0,q8_0. No license blockers. Private deploy: KMS required.

Rhea V.: Dev effort estimate: tokenizer adapter 1 dev-day, kernel tuning + CI 2 dev-days, quant build/validate 1 dev-day. Recommend a 5-business-day lead before Dedicated onboarding.

Kai L.: Canary rollout idea: small traffic to q4_0 variant, monitor latency_p95, errors, and a small QA prompt set for quality regression. Fallback to fp16 variant on anomalies.

Jordan M.: AE asked for a POC cost comparison for ~10M tokens over 30 days with streaming. Ballpark hosted vs reserved vs Dedicated?

Rhea V.: Ballpark: hosted (q4_0) ~ $1k-1.5k for 10M generation tokens + infra overhead. Reserved 30-day trial we usually discount 40-60%. Dedicated 4xA10 ~$18k/mo, 8xA10 ~$35k/mo list. I'll confirm numbers.

LegalBot: Opened LEG-3402 to add KMS addendum language and verify SOC2 artifacts. ETA 2 business days.

Kai L.: Action items: (1) Rhea -> final pricing + upload 500-sample prompts + 50-sample latency subset (redwood://sales/vectora/poc). (2) Kai -> create INF-5003 for kernel + tokenizer + quant. (3) Jordan -> send customer checklist + request SOC2 cert + KMS contact.

Jordan M.: Sending checklist now. Will schedule a 45m tech call to demo streaming + function-calling prototype. Thanks team :rocket:
